input.summary:
parts/colonnade.mjs builds the front colonnade: 8 colossal columns (end columns flare west/east), the ground/upper/ceiling gallery floors, balustrades on both floors incl. the gallery ends, and the y17 ceiling band.
It also places the rear porch (6 slim columns, shed roof, steps), the two garden stoops (x25 facing east, x70 facing west) and four porch lanterns on the centre line (one per gallery, chain + lantern).
make.sh writes a whole build.nbt; the colonnade report shows placed 1852, refused 0, off-palette none; zoom renders of the front gallery and the rear porch read correctly.
left: Entablature cells x24 and x71 at y17 (z35..36) are already tuff_bricks from the roof's eave, so the band does not extend past the gallery ceiling there (refused, left as is).
The rear porch shed roof is built inside rearPorch with the same geometry as the plan's R-rearporch; the roofs part (P2) should not repeat it, or its cells will be refused at merge.
$MCD fit flags the ground gallery (178 floor cells) and upper porch as hallways to nowhere: they are open porches by design, so the fit warning is expected there, not a defect in this part.
$MCD check reports smooth_quartz orphans at x24 y15 z38..52 on the west face. My part does not write x24, so this comes from an earlier part (shell or roofs) and needs checking there.
Not verified by eye: the rear porch post spacing (rearPorch spreads 6 posts evenly; the plan asks for x37,41,45,50,54,58) and the upper-gallery lantern clearance.

waste.what: Column volute and capital placement was specified per column by hand (which sides flare, which end columns get west/east), and the skip list of 8 column anchors was typed out.
waste.tool: colossalColumn could take a preset (front-row 'bays' with end flags) and galleryFloor could derive skip anchors from the column list.

waste.what: Balustrade runs were typed as x-ranges per floor, and the gallery-end rails along z were hand-written with g.set because balustrade() only runs along x.
waste.cost: one local helper (endRail) plus 14 hand-counted ranges, 1 retry on the state strings
waste.tool: balustrade with an axis argument (x or z) and the vocab's airOnly writer exported, so the end rails are one call.

waste.what: The entablature band was written from the plan without first checking what the roof part had already placed at x24/x71, so the step was refused at the first make.sh run.
waste.tool: A 'who owns this cell' query over the kit's parts (or parts-report.json of the previous build) before placing a band that abuts another part.

waste.what: Checking my zoomed renders and the fit output was done by eye, with the relevant zoom coordinates worked out by hand.
waste.tool: mcd render --closeups already exists; a per-part zoom preset (front gallery, rear porch) would have saved the coordinate work.

companions.task: Cut and set the 2x2 colossal column bases and capitals (y4 plinth, y16 chiseled capital with the flared quartz-stair volutes) and check the column footings against the brick plinth.
Fit the upper and ground balustrades (birch fence with quartz slab rails) and the gallery-end rails, checking their connection states along each run.
Place and measure the gallery lanterns (chain plus lantern at y8 and y15) and confirm the porch reads lit at night, plus light levels in the upper porch.
